'''October 1999 Jester's Court tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 16 October 1999. It is known from Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d78">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-18-jesters-court-10-16-99d78/ jesters-court-10-16-99], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 18 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-18-jesters-court-10-16-99d78/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 October 1999
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
